title: solidago arguta subsp. boottii
intro: Solidago arguta subsp. boottii, commonly known as Boott's goldenrod, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is native to the northeastern United States and southeastern Canada. Boott's goldenrod is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral agent, helping to relieve symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Boott's goldenrod include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
